inputs.message: How long does standard shipping take?

messages.content: How long does standard shipping take?

[1] Shipping times — Shipping times > Delivery windows
Standard shipping arrives in 3–5 business days after dispatch. Express shipping arrives in 1–2 business days after dispatch. Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding public holidays. These are estimates, not guaranteed arrival dates.

sources.content: Standard shipping arrives in 3–5 business days after dispatch. Express shipping arrives in 1–2 business days after dispatch. Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding public holidays. These are estimates, not guaranteed arrival dates.

inputs.message: What is the cost of express shipping?

messages.content: What is the cost of express shipping?

[1] Shipping costs — Shipping costs > Rates and free shipping
Standard shipping costs $5 for orders below $50 and is free for orders of $50 or more before tax. Express shipping costs $12 for every order. The checkout total shows the applicable shipping cost before payment.

sources.section: Shipping costs > Rates and free shipping
sources.content: Standard shipping costs $5 for orders below $50 and is free for orders of $50 or more before tax. Express shipping costs $12 for every order. The checkout total shows the applicable shipping cost before payment.

inputs.message: What is the return window?

messages.content: What is the return window?

[1] Return window — Return window > Return eligibility
Request a return within 30 calendar days of delivery. Items must be unused, unwashed, and in their original packaging with tags attached. Keep your order reference ready. A return request is subject to support review and is not an automatic refund.

sources.content: Request a return within 30 calendar days of delivery. Items must be unused, unwashed, and in their original packaging with tags attached. Keep your order reference ready. A return request is subject to support review and is not an automatic refund.

inputs.message: How do I start the return process?

messages.content: How do I start the return process?

[1] Starting a return — Starting a return > Return instructions
To start a return, contact support with your order reference, the item name, and the reason for returning it. Wait for return authorization and shipping instructions before mailing anything. This chat can explain the process but cannot create a return authorization yet.

sources.content: To start a return, contact support with your order reference, the item name, and the reason for returning it. Wait for return authorization and shipping instructions before mailing anything. This chat can explain the process but cannot create a return authorization yet.

inputs.message: Who pays return shipping?

messages.content: Who pays return shipping?

[1] Return shipping fees — Return shipping fees > Who pays return postage
For a change-of-mind return, the customer pays return postage using a tracked service. When support confirms a damaged or incorrect item, support provides a prepaid return label if a return is required. Do not send an item back before receiving instructions.

sources.content: For a change-of-mind return, the customer pays return postage using a tracked service. When support confirms a damaged or incorrect item, support provides a prepaid return label if a return is required. Do not send an item back before receiving instructions.

inputs.message: How long does a refund take?

messages.content: How long does a refund take?

[1] Refund timing — Refund timing > After a returned item arrives
After the warehouse receives a returned item, inspection takes up to five business days. If approved, the refund is sent to the original payment method. The payment provider may take another 5–10 business days to display it. This assistant cannot issue or guarantee refunds.

inputs.message: What should I do about a damaged item?

messages.content: What should I do about a damaged item?

[1] Damaged items — Damaged items > Report damage
Report an item that arrived damaged within seven calendar days of delivery. Keep the item and its packaging. Contact support with the order reference, a description of the damage, and clear photos of the item and packaging. Support reviews the evidence before deciding the next step.

[2] Return shipping fees — Return shipping fees > Who pays return postage
For a change-of-mind return, the customer pays return postage using a tracked service. When support confirms a damaged or incorrect item, support provides a prepaid return label if a return is required. Do not send an item back before receiving instructions.

inputs.message: I received the wrong item. What is the policy?

messages.content: I received the wrong item. What is the policy?

[1] Incorrect items — Incorrect items > Wrong product received
If you received an incorrect product, contact support within seven calendar days of delivery. Include your order reference, the item you expected, the item received, and a photo of the product label. Keep the packaging until support gives instructions.

sources.content: If you received an incorrect product, contact support within seven calendar days of delivery. Include your order reference, the item you expected, the item received, and a photo of the product label. Keep the packaging until support gives instructions.

inputs.message: An item is missing from my parcel. What should I do?

messages.content: An item is missing from my parcel. What should I do?

[1] Missing items in a package — Missing items in a package > Incomplete orders
If an item is missing from your package, first check whether the order has multiple shipments. Compare the packing slip with the items received. Contact support within seven calendar days with the order reference and missing item name if the item is not in another shipment.

inputs.message: How do I reset my account password?

messages.content: How do I reset my account password?

[1] Password reset — Password reset > Reset a forgotten password
Use the Forgot password link on the store sign-in page and enter the email address used for the account. Check spam folders for the reset email. Never send your password or reset token in chat. The synthetic pilot uses seeded accounts and does not send password reset emails.

[2] Account security — Account security > Unexpected account activity
If you notice unexpected account activity, change your password using the store password reset process and contact support. Never send full payment card details, passwords, or one-time verification codes in chat. Support will use the approved identity verification process.

inputs.message: Do you ship internationally?

messages.content: Do you ship internationally?

[1] Shipping destinations — Shipping destinations > Supported destinations
The synthetic store ships only to addresses in the contiguous United States. International destinations, Alaska, Hawaii, military addresses, and PO boxes are not supported. Check the address at checkout before ordering.

sources.content: The synthetic store ships only to addresses in the contiguous United States. International destinations, Alaska, Hawaii, military addresses, and PO boxes are not supported. Check the address at checkout before ordering.

inputs.message: Where do I find my tracking link?

messages.content: Where do I find my tracking link?

[1] Tracking a shipment — Tracking a shipment > Tracking updates
A tracking link appears in the dispatch email after an order ships. Carrier tracking can take up to 24 hours to show the first scan. Your signed-in order lookup shows the latest stored order status; do not share your password to request tracking help.

sources.content: A tracking link appears in the dispatch email after an order ships. Carrier tracking can take up to 24 hours to show the first scan. Your signed-in order lookup shows the latest stored order status; do not share your password to request tracking help.

inputs.message: Can personalized items be returned?

messages.content: Can personalized items be returned?

[1] Items excluded from returns — Items excluded from returns > Non-returnable products
Final-sale items, personalized products, opened hygiene products, and digital gift cards cannot be returned for a change of mind. If an excluded item arrives damaged or incorrect, contact support for a separate review.

sources.section: Items excluded from returns > Non-returnable products

inputs.message: How do I change the email on my account?

messages.content: How do I change the email on my account?

[1] Changing account email — Changing account email > Email address changes
To change the email address on a real store account, sign in and open Account settings. Confirm both the existing and new email addresses when prompted. If you cannot access the existing address, contact support for identity verification. The synthetic pilot does not change account emails.

If you cannot access the existing address, contact support for identity verification. The synthetic pilot does not change account emails.

inputs.message: How do I find my guest order?

messages.content: How do I find my guest order?

[1] Guest order help — Guest order help > Orders placed without an account
A guest order is linked to the email entered at checkout. Contact support with the order reference and checkout email for verification. Signing into a different account does not grant access to guest orders. The synthetic pilot only looks up orders owned by the signed-in seeded account.
